name: Repeated Broad Jump
instructions: Stand with the feet about hip-width apart and room to jump forward.
Swing the arms back, dip the hips, and jump forward as far as you can, landing on both feet.
Absorb the landing, then immediately jump forward again with little pause.
Keep each landing quiet and balanced. Do not let the knees collapse inward.
Continue for the set number of jumps. This is a series, not a single standing long jump.
